sentences.text: This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.254/2023 dated 07.12.20243registered at Police Station, Karanjiya District Dindori for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366-A and 376(2)(n) of IPC and under sections 3,4,5(l), 6 and of the POCSO Act.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that allegation against the present applicant is that he provided accommodation to the co-accused to enable him to commit the offence under the aforesaid sections.

It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix has not alleged anything against the Maksood Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166556039/
1 present applicant nor there is any allegation of commission of rape as against the present applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Merely the accommodation belonging to the present applicant was used by the main accused, his implication is unsustainable.
Therefore, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that the present applicant is also liable for commission of the offence knowing fully well the conduct of the main accused providing housing accommodation for illegitimate cohabitation by the main accused.
Thus, submits that the application deserves to be dismissed.

4 . Having heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, record reflects that so far as the present applicant is concerned, it is not the case of the prosecution that the he has committed the alleged offence.
The prosecutrix was kept at the house of the present applicant where the offence was committed by the accused Sunil Kumar Maravi.
5. Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant - Maksood Khan shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
8.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
